name: RX-01 Sight
teaser: Battlefield 4 Reflex Sight now in Tarkov for all the Battlefield 4 enjoyers
description_html:
I believe in Battlefield 4 Reflex Sight supremacy… so I ported it to Tarkov!

The RX-01 Reflex Sight can be found on level 2 Mechanic.

INSTALLATION

- Drag and drop the user folder into your SPT root folder

CREDITS

- Models and textures from Battlefield 4.

- Many thanks to GrooveypenguinX for the codebase and teaching me all I know about item creation.

- Thank you to EpicRangeTime for teaching me how to make custom attachments and helping me fix the hierarchy.

- And a huge thanks to all of the devs of SPT and WTT community for helping me get into modding.
